'''Ryan Coller''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 10th at [[2000 Minneapolis Grand Slam]] on 21 October 2000, according to Rich Jeffery's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1389">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-26-minnesota-grand-slam-by-one-armd1389/ minnesota-grand-slam-by-one-arm], DeckTech (Rich "ONE-ARM" Jeffery, 26 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-26-minnesota-grand-slam-by-one-armd1389/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
